b: Early next morning one of us said she wasn't well and stayed in bed.. No one else.. our very own Kovai Sarala.. She'd been taking antibiotics for a blocked nose and fever. If our Professor SSR madam knew, she'd have torn into her.. If you take antibiotics for every random viral illness, later the medicines won't work for serious illnesses..You'd have to give new medicines.. So I gave her one of the Piriton tablet family (then, since she got better straight away, she thought it was some magic medicine and kept asking for it every day.. That was a moment I felt proud to be a doctor)

Telling her to rest, the four of us set off to roam the town.. First a Greek-style coffee shop. Painted white and blue.. You can sit there and look at the sea.. Take photos.. Lots of white people were doing just that.. We went in, looked around everything and looked at the price of coffee.. This won't work, we said, and left.. On the way, someone was playing with a puppy.. When we went close, it was a monkey.. Without a word it played with him.. Seems their monkeys are like the Vietnamese.. Our monkeys would have grabbed everything and flown off by now

Oh, I forgot to tell you.. In Vietnam we were going from the south towards the north.. Think of it as the Spring of the North..Da Nang is a coastal city facing the eastern sea.. But it's hill country.. Here you can see the beauty of mountain and sea meeting…. But maybe it was the day we went .. Not much breeze.. Terribly humid.. Even without sun we sweated terribly.. Like the stewing heat when the clouds gather before rain.. Drinking water wasn't enough.. .. Best to buy lots of water and keep it.

After looking around there we went off to see a lake.. It was Google that showed there was a path like that.. There was no signboard.. The path was like the one in the film Vettaiyaadu Vilaiyaadu where those guys take girls and murder them.. I thought maybe Sing Keeth was taking me there to get revenge for some school fight.. So in fear I sent my live location to Mithra.. She didn't even look at it

When we went in, set back from the road there was a big lake with something like a little bridge on it.. Not as beautiful as in the pictures.. What is this, we said, looked a bit like we'd been cheated, and left thinking at least the next place would be good
And it was a good place too
note: "Spring of the North" (Vadakkin Vasantham) was the name of a Sri Lankan government development programme for the north. Vettaiyaadu Vilaiyaadu (2006) is a Tamil crime thriller. Piriton is a common antihistamine.
